title: Rational surface singularities persist on birational local models
statement: Let $R\subseteq S$ be an injective local extension of commutative domains having the same field of fractions. Assume $R$ is a normal Nagata local domain of dimension $2$ defining a rational singularity [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-per-rational-surface-singularity]. Assume $S$ is a normal local domain of dimension $2$, essentially of finite type over $R$, meaning a localization of a finitely generated $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Then $S$ defines a rational singularity.
